concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-pay-out-to-bank-accounts-bank-payout-request]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service Transfers API request guide for third-party bank payouts, one-off/token counterparty, priority fallback, optional approval and future one-attempt execution; HTTP 2XX is not bank receipt.
warnings: Keep source balance-account debit, request acceptance, booked transfer and beneficiary-bank receipt distinct; TEST bank fixtures are not LIVE route evidence.

Future-date table requires executionDate.date, but Java/PHP/C#/Go/TypeScript examples set timezone only; do not treat those samples as complete requests (raw 2144-2148, 2235-2246, 2307-2321, 2385-2401, 2511-2524, 2679-2692).

Processing-window prose names the Balance Platform configured default zone, while the optional timezone field table defaults to Europe/Amsterdam; the source does not say which controls when a timezone is supplied (raw 2133, 2148).
